tei:div.tei:p: shes bton na/ mtho ris su skye/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas bton na gzugs khams/ spyi gtsug nas bton na gzugs med thig sgo gzhan yi ges bkag ste/le'i gzugs lus can/ /spyi gtsug nas gtsang ma ris lnga steng ni steng du gnas pa yi/ /spyi gtsug na yar 'gro na thar pa thob par 'dod pa yang yod 'gro dang 'ong bar yongs su/ rab tu grags/ /sna las bton na gnod sbyin dag tu 'gyur//rna ba dag las bton na/grub rig sngags 'chang*/pa'i lha/ /mi'am ci/ gal te mig las shes 'gro na/ /mi rnams kyi ni g.yon pa las tha mal pa/ g.yas pa las/rgyal por 'gyur/ /srid pa'i sgo las yi dwags te/ /gci las de bzhin byol song ngo*/ /dmyal ba brgyad ni btung min pas/ /bshang ba'i lam/ ngan song gsum la sogs par 'gro ba de ltar spangs phyir rigs kyi bu/ /srid pa'i 'pho b.las kyi stobs kyis sems can thams cad 'gro ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gang phyir sgo yi khyad par ni/ /'khor ba'i dbye ba mtho ris dang ngan song giyang dag 'byung*/ /de phyir sgo yi khyad par gyis/ / nang gi 'chi rtags mnyam par bzhag pas rtogs par byas la rnal 'byor pa yis mnyam bzhag pa| |'pho ba'i dus 'chi ba dus la bab zer na/kyi thob pa yi/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma rtogs par byas la 'chi bslu la sogs pa byas kyang ma bzlogs na 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor bya bar/ bstan blta bar bya zer/pa nyid/ /rtib dang chu sogs rims la sogs pas ma phye ba'i/ /ste rims ma byung ba'o byung na 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor mi nus/ yang na 'jig rten pas brnyas pas dus las zla drug tsam gyi gong du/'pho ba'i rnal 'byor dam pa nyid/ /'pho ba'i sngon du rlung bum pa can bsgom bum pa sngon du bya ba'i cho ga dang por brtsams nas goms par bya/ni/ /sgo rnams thams cad nas rlung mi rgyu bar bya ba'i phyir sa bon gyis dgag cing bslab/rengs par byed/ /sa bon dgod pa bstan pa'i phyir mchod rten sgrogs pa lnga yi mchod rten gyi/rnams kyi sgo ni smin mtshams/

hūm̐ lcags sgrogs ltar 'brel/lnga/ /'i yi ge hūm̐ cha lnga/sgo yi bug pa par bsgom par bya/ bsgom ḍā ki'i ṭi ka las gser sgo/pa smin mtshams su hūm̐ bsam/ ser po ni/ /de yi smin mtshams pas/dma' ba'i mgrin par/sgo lte ba/nyid kyi/ /de la 'og gi sgo ru ni/ /zer/ sa bon chu ltar dkar sum bkod/po nyid/ /gci ba'i lam bshang bar btung dang btung min me yi ni/ /yi ge gzhan dgod pa sngar bstan de yi sa bon 'bar ba ltar/ /bu dgod/de de ltar yi ge bkug ste bum pa can bslab|yi dang 'pho ba'i bum pa can/po'i dbugs kyi yang*//k+ṣuṃ/dmar/bshang ba/

dkar/ mgrin | suṃ/ ser rna/ yuṃ/ sngo mig 1dang po'i dang por bstan pa bzhin te gzhan yang gser gyi sgo k+ṣuṃ yig gnyis su hūm̐ sngon po sna dang rna ba dag la yuṃ dmar po/khar ni hūm̐ dkar po dgod do//2de la shin hūm̐/ lte| snying*/ spyi/ sna/ k+ṣum̐ gci/ tu mnyam par bzhag dbu gas ni bum pa can/pas bsgom/ /bya/ lus ni rlung gi mdog tu ste rlung rnal 'byor dngos/gi de'i bsgom pa hūm̐ gilus kyi kha dog dang*/ /lta bu ste sngon po/ sems ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ zer rlung gi dkyil 'khor sems kyi snying khar rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hi ka hūm̐ bsgom zhes pa'o/ /ni/ /rlung gi sa bon rtsa ba rnams/ /'og tu yuṃ bsgom/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yuṃ bsgom/ sa yi rtsa ba can/ /aṃ thig le lte ba'i aṃ/sgra dang ldan pa yi/ /sems kyi sa mar la drang zer/bon gyis ni dgug /rdo rje can lte ba'i yuṃ/gyi sa bon gyis/ /1rdo rje drag mo'i sa bon gyi// lcags kyu la sogs sbyar bar bya/ /2rang stong pa la sogs pa/ sngon du song bas sgo dgu bcings te/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mar bskyed la lte bar aṃ/ snying khar rlung gi dkyil 'khor la de'i steng du hūm̐/ rlung gi 'og tu yuṃ/ steng du yang yuṃ/ dbugs phyir 'gro na yuṃ 'og ma hi/ gong ma la ka bkod la/ nang du 'jug tsa na yuṃ gong ma la hi/ 'og ma la bka' bkod la lte bar aṃ gi 'od kyis bskul bas dbugs phyin 'byung ba'i dus su hi ka zhes drag tu brjod pas snying kha'i yi ge de rnams mgo bo'i klad pa'i nang du 'phul la nang du rngub tsa na hi ka zhes rngub pas yi ge de dag mgo thur la bstan pa yang snying kha nas thur la 'ong*/ de ltar lan nyer gcig tu goms pas gang nas 'dod pa nas 'pho bar 'gyur ro//'jigs ma'i lcags drag mo'i zer aṃ dang*/kyu 1'i sa bon spyi gtsug gi hūm̐ ngo*/

2ltar 'dren/ 3'i hi ka sa bon spyi gtsug gi hūm̐ ngo*/ la sogs sbyar| |hi ka sbyar ba ni hi yuṃ 'og ma'i 'og tu bri/ ka ni yuṃ gong ma'i 'og tu bri'o/ /grangs tshang nas 'pho ba gnas ni bcu dang nyi shu nyi shu rtsa hi ka gcig dbugs rnams kyi/ /snying kha lte ba'i aṃ gi 'od kyis||gnas las drag por rlung sems gyen du 'dus/ drang bar bya/ ni/ /snying kha las snying kha'i rlung dang sems rtsa bzhi'i gnas las aṃ gi 'od kyis gyen la 'phul ba'o//'jigs ma rngub pas mar la/dgug |go snying kha dang mgrin pa la sogs pa ste/ spyi gtsug la sogs gang 'dod nas/'phang gnas ni go 'phang steng*/ /bug pa dgu yi steng mas spyi gtsug so/ /lus blta ba'i cho ga 'og nas ston mdzod spu skra dkar spyi bo'i haṃ las bab pa'i byang sems lte bar phab pas skra dkar 'joms pas/sa bon gyi/ /hi ka bzlas pa'am a hūm̐ la bya yi ge phyed dang hi ka gnyis kyi zer/ ni sbyangs/ /aṃ/ drag hika zhes drag tu nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ pa'i sgra rlung gis bskyod pa'i aṃ gi sa bon gyis hūm̐ la bsnan pa'o/ /yis brjod nas ni/ /brgyad kyi mtha' yi sa bon ha/ gyis/ / hi ka'i i ā li ha dang ka kā li/'jigs ā li/ dang 'jigs kā li/pa'i sde nga ro drag por sbyar bar bya zer/tshan gyi/ /dang po ka tshan/la sogs dang po kayi/ /ka de yi ge phyed par sbyar nas ni/ /rlung gi snying kha'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'og tu yuṃ bsgom pa/sa bon 'og ma la| |'og phyogs kyi yuṃ/ snying kha'i hūm̐ sgra ni sgra yis lte ba'i aṃ yar klad pa'i nang du/bskul bar bya| |rlung gi yuṃ/sa bon ldan pa nang du rngub tsa na hika bskul bas yi ge thur la/dang*/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi hūm̐/sems kyis ni/ /zhar la skra dkar 'joms pa bstan gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhir rtsa gcig hika gam gnas rnams brjod pa/ la zer/ni/ /de nas steng nas steng su tsaka tu/du mchog

/der hūm̐ sngon po kha thur bltas bsam ste/ lte ba'i aṃ gi 'od kyis zhu nas bdud rtsi phab pas skra dkar 'ching ba/ smin mtshams su haṃ la hika'i bdud rtsi phab ste lce chung gi suṃ la babs pas lus tshim par bsgom na lus bzang skra dkar gnyer ma sel/rnal 'byor pa yi skra dkar bas/ / spyi'i bza' ba de khu ba si h+la dang bsres par zos pas skra dkar 'joms steng gi yi ge bza' bar bya/ /thar pa mchog gi 'pho ba yin pas bu ga dgu yi steng mchog nas/ / 'phral du yid kyis mkha' spyod du/'pho bar byed/ /phan yon/ sngar nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang*/ /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang*/ /chom rkun las kyi longs spyod pa/ /gong du 'pho ba 'di yi lam gyis snang bas mun pa sel bar ltar/grol 'gyur te/ / myong bar ma nges pa'i las su 'gro sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /srid pa'i skyon las shing tu ring*/ /dper na 'dam las skyes pa yi/ /pad+ma 'dam dang chu dang lci ba la sogs pa ltar/gzi brjid dri ma med/ /de bzhin lus sogs 'dam las ni/'dam dang 'dra ba'i|sogs lus kyi ni/ /ye shes sku ni rang rang gos pa med/'dod pas/ /'pho ba'i dus bzung ba'i 'thad pa dus thob pa na 'chi ltas ni byung zlog thabs ma byung na 'pho bya ste/ /dus 'chi ltas ma byung pa'am/ byung yang zlog thabs yod bzhin du 'pho ba byas na/min lha ni gsod pa nyid/ / de phyir lus kyi phyi'i/mtshan 'chi ltas/shes nas/ /blo dang ldan pas rnam 'byor 'pho ba/ brtsam| |'di gdan bzhi dang bstun pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi spyir rang lha gang byed kyi bya'o gsung rnal 'byor 'pho ba'i/bsgrub bya bsgrub pa'i lha/khyad par las/ /ji ltar 'pho ba'i dus kyi lha'i rnal 'byor/de nyid rdo rje nyon/ /bsod nams tshogs bsags song nas mnyam nyid mos pa la dmigs pas stong par/ sems kyi dngos pos ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i skabs kyi dag pa gsum/

thams cad las/ /snying gi ni stong pa ste rnal 'byor pa'i ye shes rdo rje snying zhes kyang 'dug dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /tsaṇ+ḍā lī nyi shu rtsa gsum pa zhar la bstan sangs rgyas lnga yi sa bon bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/rnams/ /'di yi nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar| |ngo bo sems kyis bsam/mtshon par bya/ /sngar gsungs shū n+ya tās/stong pa nyid kyi ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid stong*/yang dag ldan/ /stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma de'i steng du hūm̐ las 'od 'phros bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma/ pad+ma de'i steng du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las ye shes mkha' 'gro hūm̐ la gnas pa'i sems kyis ni/ /gzugs sogs thams cad gzhig par bya/ /mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su yang*/ /sa bon hūm̐/gyis ni hūm̐ las ye shes mkha' 'gro gzugs bskyed nas/ / pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par ni/ /ye shes mkha' 'gror bdag nyid bsam/ / zhal gsum pa dang phyag drug nyid/ /spyan gsum dbu rgyan gyis ni brgyan/ /zhal gsum bzhad dbus/dang g.yas/khrod dang g.yon/sgeg pa dang*/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /kun da zla ba'i mdog ltar dkar/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /ba spu'i bu ga nas sangs rgyas sprin ni spro bar bya/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du gnas/ /dang por mda' ni dgod par bya/ /de bzhin gnyis par lcags kyu nyid/ /gsum par rdo rje 'phyar ba'o/ /g.yon na sdig mdzub la/zhags pa nyid/ /gnyis par dpag bsam shing lcug ma/ /gsum par gzhu yi go chas khyab| |'od zer phreng ba du ma dang*/ /sems gzhan du mi 'phro bar dbugs ni g.yo ba med par rlung bum pa can/bsgom/ /ste de sems dpa' sum rtseg sa bon brgyad ni gong du 'pho ba bzhin sgo brgyad la dgod par/brtson pa yi/ /pāṃ k+ṣu la sogs pa yi ge rnam dgod yan lag brgyad la/dgod par bya/

/u aṃ ā tsaṇ+ḍā lī nyer bzhi pa/ li kā ha/li rab sbyor bas/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sa bon bstan gsung*/ji ltar btus pa'i sa bon hūm̐/bzhin/ /sa bon dang sku mdog thams cad kha dog dkar rnams rnam shes dbrog pa'i cho ga yis/ /pha rol 'gro ba bshad par bya/ /zhes ḍā ka las 'byung*/ kyi/ /sa bon zla ba'i 'od zer ldan/ /snying gi pad+ma'i chu shing me tog gi /snying la hūm̐ gi thig le/sgong skyes bzhag par bya/ /hūm̐ de yi dbus su zhu ba dang bde ba/ye shes su/dang*/ /nang na rnam shes dbyung bar mi 'dod pa'i sgo rnam khur/par shes pa lhan cig tu zer/pas/ /rtog pa'i dngos po'i ngo bos bsgom par bya/ /rnam pa yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par 'dug kyang ngo bo byang sems zhu bde'i ngo bo rlung g.yo ba med cing 'tshe ba med// dang po rlung*/ de nas srog rtsol/ de nas hika bdag gi rnam par shes pa g.yo bar bya de gong du 'pho ba las phyi rol te grong gzhan du 'jug pa'i/ nas phyi rol rang lus dang*/rnal 'byor rnams/ /dang po bdag gi rnam shes dbrog de nas gzhan gyi dbrog de'i rjes su 'pho ba dngos rnam par mkhas pas gzung bar bya/ /gnas gnyis lte ba dang snying kha/kyi ni dag ni bsam pa aṃ dang hūm̐/ zer/ sems dang ni/ /rlung lte bar 'og sor bzhi dor bar/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du aṃ hūm̐/gi dkyil 'khor sems kyis ni//de de yi steng du nyi ma dang zer/yi dbus su me nyid de/ /me yi dbus su nyi nyi ma'i mdog aṃ dmar/ma nyid/ /snying khar hūm̐ bsgom pa ni ā u aṃ/li ha/kā li ldan pa yi/ /hūm̐/ lte ba'i sa bon aṃ/de nyid dmar po'o// rnal 'byor pa yi khyad par du/ /dbyung dbugs phyir dbyung tsam na lte ba'i rlung gi steng du/ mas yar de'i steng du/ ded/ des/ aṃ dmar po/ gi 'od kyis snying kha'i kha thur du/

hūm̐ chu shing me tog rlung gis bskyod pa ltar bskul te klad pa'i nang du tshang gis 'phul bar bsam/ nang du rngub tsa na hūm̐ de nyid kha thur la bltas nas mar snying khar byung*/ de ltar yang dang yang du byas la tshegs med/dang rngub pa'i bzlas pa bya// ye shes sa bon dbus su ni/ /'byung ba yis ni bsnun bya zhing*/ /rngubs pas snying kha'i ye shes ni/ /me tog lta bur thur la/bsnun par bya/ /phyir dbyung dang nang du/ dbyung min bzlas pas ni/ /dbyung dang rngub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag nyid kyi sems|phyi rol tu ni gzhan gyi lus la 'jug par/byed/ /dbyung de ci lan gcig gis 'grub bam zhe na yang dang yang du bya/ba'i mtshan nyid kyi yar 'phul bar/mtshon par bya/ /rngub pa'i rnam par shes pa ni 'od gsal ba ste snang yang de rang bzhin gyis gsal lo/ /mtshan nyid mtshon par bya| |dbyung dang rngub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rnal 'byor pa sems mnyam pa gsung mnyam nyid de nyid bsgom pas ni/ /mnyam bzhag dngos po'i rang bzhin gyis/ / 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas pha rol po gzhon nu'i/pha rol rnams kyi lus| |phyi rol gyi shes pa phrogs te bdag gir bya ba/sgrub pa pos ni rnam rang gi lus su/ par sprul| |de nas pha rol gyi lus drod yal ba de la gzhan gyi pha rol la bdag gi rnam shes 'pho ba/ sems 'phos pa'i/kyi rjes su shul du bdag gisems/ 'pho ba'i/ nyi ma'i lam nas byung nas ni// bdag dang lha mo'i cha ldan pa/ /bsgrub bya'i snying gi dbus zhugs nas/ /rlung gis me ni sbar bar bya/ /de yi rnam shes blangs nas ni/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor la ni gzhug /bsgrub bya'i rnam shes phrogs nas ni/ /'og gi k+ṣa yi 'khor lo sbyar/ /ji srid zad kyi bar du ni/ /lha mo lkugs pa bzhin du gnas/ /zhes so// rnam par mkhas pas shes par bya/ /rang gi lte bar aṃ dmar pos snying kha'i hūm̐

rin chen 'bar ba lta bu rang gi 'od kyis khyab par byas nas/ bskul te de gnyis 'bar ba sna nas phyung la pha rol gyi sna nas zhugs te snying kha'i sa bon bskul te tshur bdag gi rna ba g.yon nas/ la zhugs nas me'i dbus su lte ba'i 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor k+ṣa 'bar ba las/ bsreg par bsgom/ 'dis bsgrub bya la gnod par 'gyur ro//bsgom dang bzlas pa'i khyad par dbugs phyir byung tsa na lte ba'i aṃ snying kha'i hūm̐ gi sems kyi bdag nyid bskul te sna bug g.yas nas byung nas phyi rol du rngub pa'i dus su pha rol gyi snying kha'i hūm̐ la bstim/ pha rol gyi hūm̐ sems kyi bdag nyid can de dbugs phyir byung tsa na sna bug g.yon nas nang du bkug ste bdag gi lte ba'i 'og gi k+ṣa rab tu 'bar ba la bsreg par bya/ de ltar ma grub kyi bar du lkugs pa dang 'dra bar bya/ 'di la nang gi sbyor ba zhes bha wa pas bshad/ don pha rol gdug pa can bsgral ba/ gyis/ /de lta bu la mnyam seng ge rnam rol phyag rgya ni/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bcing bar bya/ /khyod kyi gnas kyi rnal 'byor las/ /rtag tu srog dang rtsol ba bya/ /'byed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /bdag sngar gyi/ gi lus ni spangs nas ni/ / sngags pas gzhan gyi grong zhugs te/ /cho ga 'dis ni bya ba nyid/ /de nyid rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang gi lus kyi rnal 'byor 'dod/ /de nas phan yon mang po gsungs so/ /par bzhag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /gnyis las grong gzhan du 'pho legs pa'i lam ni bsam byas 'di gong du rnal grol gyi phyag rgya la sogs pa sbyong bar ḍā ka las gsal/na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med| |ye shes kyi de kho na nyid la bzhi las dang po de kho na dngos de nas bdag gi sems/ye shes gzugs pha rol po'i/ gyur dang*/ /de phyir mar ma'i rnam rang gisems kyi/ /gnyis med ye shes kyi ngang ni gnas pa/rnam par mkhas pas nang ltar gyi/las grong gzhan du 'jug pa/

rnams byed/ /nyan thos la sogs pa thams cad la gnas pa'i/ de nyid ni/ /pho ba ni nyan thos la sogs pa'i thun mong*/ thams cad sems spros bral du gnas pa legs par bshad pa bsgrags pa nyid/ /shes ltar dri ma dang bral ba'i/ sems ni brtan ye shes ngos bzung gi gdams ngag gis glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral bar byed cing de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa mnan par byas nas/ byas nas/ /bzung na/ bem po las log ste rig pa'i ngo bor gnas pas mar me'i rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de rtogs pa'i thabs/ spros pa thams cad dmigs nas ni/ /bskyed rim spros pa rtogs pa/ nyid ni spros med ye shes ngang gis gnas pa/ byed/ /rang bzhin gyi/ rnala'abyor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes/dmigs nas ni/ /spros pa'i rnam pa 'di dag thams cad yongs su spangs/ /de nyid ma rtogs pa'i snang ba kye rgyu mtshan/bcom ldan 'das gang gi ye shes khyad par du 'phags pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ye shes kyi bye bragabaka' stsal pa/ /rten gyi sgo nas ye shes rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ / gsang ba'i bsod nams las grub pa'i lha'i shes pa gsal bar blta/ me sems mngon shes yod pas me long zhes bya gzhan la bstan pas gsang ba'o/ /long ye shes lha'i/ khro zhe sdang me las/ bo'i ye shes lha ma yin/ /sbyin mi shes pas yi dwags so zer yi dwags ye shes nyi ma bkres skom gyis gdung*/rnams/ /zhan pa ste zer/ btso bsreg dmyal ba 'jigs shing khro ba las so/ /ngu ba nyid/ /rmogs gti rmongs shing rmugs pas byol song ngo*//mug ye shes byol song rnams| |bem po sems med brtan mi la lnga char tshang*/ pa la sogs pa/ /la sems med do| |brtan pa la sogs pa'i sems med de/ ye shes lnga ru phye nas bshad/ zer lnga mi la ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru shes par bya/ /gdan bzhi las/yi dbye bas ye shes bsgrags/ /glen shes pa med pa'am blo med pa gdams ngag dang ma phrad pa/

zhing lkugs pas ngag ma tshang bas/ khebs pa rmongs pa/yi/ /bu chung byis pa'i ngar 'dzin dang bcas pa de'i/shes pa'i shes pa can| |shes pa'i phan yon ye shes de lta bu de su thod pas mi shes na sus shes snyam na/de nyid khyad par can/ /dang de gang las shes na/rnal 'byor bstan bcos thabs shes gnyis med rtogs pa'i gzhung*/khyad par las/ /de ltar ye shes shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa de skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ /rdo rje 'chang nga yi ye shes kyis bskul byin gyis brlabs/bas/ /de lta bas na mkhas pas rnal 'byor ye shes kyi de kho na nyid ston pa'i gzhung*/bstan bcos la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes ston pa'i gzhung la 'gal/'bad pas de bas zer/ dad pa bskyed par bya| |sgra sogs phyi rol bstan bcos la sogs sgra/ /dper na gar mkhan kha dog bzhin| |kha dog sna tshogs bsgyur bas na nang gi lugs kyi rang bzhin mi rtogs/ de bzhin phyi'i sgra dang bstan bcos rnams kyi rtogs pas rang bzhin mi rtogs rnala'abyor bstan bcos rjes btsal bas| |spyod dang grol ba thob/ ba'i gnas su bya/ /ye shes kyi de kho na gang la rtogs par bstan pa snying bskyed/po las ni snying po mchog /rnal 'byor zhal mchog khyod la bshad| |brgyad pa las mu staigs kyi ye shes sngar bstan pa rtag pa dang brtan par 'dod pa zhig 'jig pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags rnams ni de nyid 'dus pa'i dum bu dang por lha tshul mi 'dra ba bzhin sngags kyang mi 'dra'o/ /des kha bskang*/ ḍā ka dang po dang bcu par kha bskang*/ rigs bzhi yum bzhi gong du brjod pas 'dir med/ he ru ka bcu bdun pa rtsa rgyud du kha bskang*/ lha mo bco lnga gsal bar bshad/ he ru ka bzhi cha mthun/ bde mchog bdun pa dngos kyi ste rtsa rgyud lnga bdun du btu ba gsungs kyang sngags ma gsungs pas kha bskang*/

yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa le'u brgyad par cha/ drag po'i gdan can mnyam sbyor kha/ de'i 'khor phyag bcu drug pa dang 'dra/ 'od zer can dang lo ma can sgyu drwar kha/ don grub kyi snying po ni rgyud de thams cad kyi spogs chog go /gtor ma ḍā kar cha/ sa sbyangs pa he badz+ra tshul/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bcu gsum gdan bzhi tshul/ mchod pa cha/ mgron dgug pa ḍā kar cha/ go cha tshul sngags rnams kyi ni mtshan nyid ni/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /byang sems brgyad kyi man tra na hi oṃ rdo rje sems dpa'i/badz+rā mṛ ta ma hā su kha haṃ swāhā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ swāhā/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /nang gi 'phar ma'i rigs lnga yum bzhi bdun par bstan pas 'dir ma bshad/go sla bas de'i phyi'i 'phar ma'i oṃ āḥ.aṃ haṃ swāhā rdo rje drag mo'i'o// oṃ āḥ.āṃ haṃ swāhā rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.iṃ haṃ swāhā 'dod chags rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.īṃ haṃ swāhā rdo rje zhi ba ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.uṃ haṃ swāhā rdo rje gnod sbyin ma'i'o/ /gsum pa la mtshams bzhir dbang ldan nas brtsams te oṃ āḥ.ūṃ haṃ swāhā rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.aṃ haṃ swāhā sgra'i rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.aṃḥhaṃ swāhā sa'i rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ haṃ swāhā gling bu ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.au+oṃ haṃ swāhā pi wang ma'i'o// oṃ āḥ.eṃ haṃ swāhā mu kun da'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.aiṃ haṃ swāhā rdza rnga ma'i'o/ /'phar ma bzhi pa'o|oṃ āḥbadz+ra aṃ ku sha dza haṃ swāhā rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā she hūm̐ haṃ swāhā rdo rje zhags pa ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ haṃ swāhā rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i'o| |oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho haṃ swāhā rdo rje dril bu ma'i'o/ /spyan la sogs pa'i sngags ni sngags pas bzlas par bya'o/

/oṃ ṛṃ swāhā me tog ma'i'o/ /oṃ ṝṃ swāhā bdug pa ma'i'o/ /oṃ l̥ṃ swāhā dri ma'i'o/ /oṃ l̥̄ṃ swāhā mar me'i'o/ /'di dag ni rdo rje sems rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sngags/dpa'i'o/ /oṃ hrīḥswāhā he drug pa'i gsung*/ phyag rgya bcu drug pa'i'o/ /ru ka'ilha bcu bdun pa'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ye sid+dhi pa ra ma yo ge shwa ri ka pā la mā la dhā ri ne/ ru dhi ra pri ye sh+ma shā na bā si ni hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā dkar mo'i'o| |oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍe shwa ri kha ṭ+wāṃ gi ma hi badz+ra ni ka pā la mā la ku ṭe/ ā kaḍ+ḍha ā kaḍ+ḍha sarba duṣ+ta hri da ya mā kaḍ+ḍha ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa chom rkun ma'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a pa ra dzi te ma ra

cha pa ra ma ja gu h+ye ka pā la mā lā bi bhū ṣi te sarba duṣ+ta mo ha ni pri ye e h+ye hi bha ga wa ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa ri ba hu bi bi dha/ be sha dha ri ni sarba duṣ+ta ni wa ra ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa rab tu rmongs ma'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra be tā lī kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ta ni bi kri ta be sha dha ri ni bi kṛ tā laṃ pa ka rā bhu ṣi te ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma bi laṃ pa cha ma bi laṃ pa ja sa mā ya ma nu sma ra pra be sha ya maṇ+ḍal ma d+ye u tha pa ya sarba hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ro langs ma'i'o/ /oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wa ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa ri bha hūm̐ bi bi dha be sha dha ri ni/ sarba ta thā ga ta duṣ+ta sa mā ya ma nu sma ra/ ha na ha na| raṅga raṅga/ raṅga pa ya raṅga pa ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ sarba bhu ta nan/ te na te na/ rta pa ya rta pa ya/ haḥha ha ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐/ na ra tha ma 'di bla dpe la med phaṭa puk+ka sī'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shu la gri bhin dha bhin dha sarba dush+ta hri da ya ma a kar+ṣa ya/ a kar+sha ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ nirma tha nirma tha/ mā ra ya mā ra ya|ma bi lam pa cha ma bi lam pa ja sa mā ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa gdol pa mo'i'o// oṃ badz+ra ma he shwa ri haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ ha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bha k+ṣa ya sarba duṣ+ta nirma tha hri da ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā ghasma rī'i'o/ /oṃ sum bha ni dīp+ta sa ma ya badz+re hūm̐ phaṭa he ru ka dang mtshungs pa'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra baṃ she hūm̐ swāhā gling bu ma'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi ni hūm̐ swāhā pi wang ma'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mu kun+de hūm̐ swāhā mu kun da'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mri taṃ ge hūm̐ swāhā rdza rnga ma'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bā ṭa bha mu khi yo gī shwa ri ni hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ dzaḥrta gdong ma'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra daṃṣ+ta bā ra ha mu khi traṃ ba traṃ ba hūm̐/ rdo rje phag gdong ma'i'o| |oṃ tsan+d+ra sur+ya hu ta sā ni siṃ ha ni rna de siṃ hi bak+t+re siṃ hi bak+ṣi ni ṭaṃ ni ṭaṃ ni haṃ baṃ baṃ seṅge'i gdong ma'i'o/

/badz+ra dha dhu saṃ dzi wa ni ma hā yak+ṣi ni shwa na ru pi nī ma hā mra la ya nirna de ṭa ma ru pi ni trān tra ṭa ho khyi'i gdong ma'i'o/ /swāhā zhes bya ba ni thams cad du'o/ /'di rnams ni he ru ka bcu bdun/'khor gyi sngags so zer/dang bcas pa'i'o/ /oṃ aṃ swāhā bdag med ma'i'o/ /oṃ āṃḥswāhā rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ iṃ swāhā dkar mo'i'o/ /o+oṃ īṃ swāhā chu'i rnal 'byor ma'i'o/ /oṃ uṃ swāhā rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /oṃ ūṃ swāhā puk+ka sa'i'o/ /oṃ ṛṃ swāhā ri khrod ma'i 'o/ /oṃ ṝṃ swāhā gdol pa ma'i'o/ /oṃ l̥ṃ swāhā g.yung mo'i 'o/ /oṃ l̥̄ṃ swāhā dkar mo'i'o/ / oṃ eṃswāhā chom rkun ma'i'o/ /oṃ aiṃ swāhā ro langs ma'i'o/ /oṃ oṃ swāhā ghasma rī'i'o| |oṃ auṃ swāhā sa spyod ma'i'o/ /oṃ aṃ swāhā mkha' spyod ma'i'o/ /'di rnams ni bdag med ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i'o/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā kye'i rdo rjephyag bcu drug pa'i 'i snying po'o/ /oṃ trai lo kya a k+ṣe pa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā phyag gnyis pa'i'o/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā phyag bzhi pa'i'o/ /oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā phyag drug pa'i'o/ /brtag pa bdun pa dngos nas he ru ka phyag bzhi pa nas 'bum pa'i bar du bsgom la de'i rnal 'byor la gnas te khu ba 'gugs par 'gyur ba de'i sngags oṃ na mo bha ga wa bcom ldan 'das/te dpa' bo'i dbang phyug bi re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā bskal pa chen po'i me 'dra ba/kap+lāg+ni san+ni bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭa mu ku ral pa'i cod pan mi zad pa/ṭot+ka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃsh+ta kā ra mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa skrag la 'jigs pa'i zhal can/lo gra bhi ṣa na mu kha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ sa ha stong*/sra bhu phyag dza bha su 'od gsal ba/ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ pa ra shu pa dgra s+t+wa zhags pa thogs pa/ sho d+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ga dha ri ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ stag gi lpags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa/bya gh+ra dzi nāṃ ba ra dha ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā dud pa chen po dang mun pa dang 'dra ba'i sku dhumra an dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsakra saṃ bha ra'i phyag 'bum pa'i'o/ /brtag pa gsum pa dngos nas bstan pa'i oṃ shrī he he ru ru kam̐ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā dur khrod la dges pa phyag gnyis pa'i'o/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra sarba duṣ+ta sa mā ya mu tra pra bhaṃ dza ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ /drag po'i gdan can gyi phyag gnyis pa'i'o/ /oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rig pa'i rgyal po'i'o/ /'di rnams ni he ru ka 'byung ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā yi ge bcu drug po 'di dag ni mkha' 'gro ma'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ mā rī ts+yai swāhā 'od zer can gyi snying po'o// bdun pa dngos nas/oṃ mā rī ts+yai bat+ta li ba rā li ba rā ha mu khi swāhā nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba mā ra pra sha ma ni hūm̐ hūm̐ ma ho da ri phaṭa/ ri khrod ma shing lo can gyi'o/ /las 'di grub na bzlas pa dang las bsgrub pa'i sngags med pa thams cad la 'dis bya oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sh+yā kar+ṣa ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha ban dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kā li tardza ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ti gṛh+na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li la hūm̐ badz+ra muta ka ya hūm̐/ sngags 'di rnams ni shin tu grub pa ste don yod pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ḍā ka i maṃ ba ra hi/gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mā ya dam tshig can khyod/s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya hoḥde ltar lan gsum/ bzhi/ lngar bzlas nas gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/

/rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ kha zo gnyis/ kha khā hi nges par zo gnyis/khā hi sarba thams cad/yak+ṣa gnod sbyin/rak+ṣa srin po/sa bhu ta 'byung po/ pre ta yi dwags/pi sha tsa sha za/tsaun+mā dā smyo byed/pasma ra brjed byed/ḍā ka ḍā ki mkha' 'gro/n+ya da ya| i 'di/maṃ bha liṃ gtor ma/gṛh+nan zungs shig tu sa mā ya rak+ṣan+tu dam tshig can srungs shigam ma sarba sid+dhiṃ me pra yats+tshan+tu dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol cigahūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūm̐ byin gyis rlabs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sho dha ya sho dha ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa sbyangs pa'i sngags so/ /brtag pa gsum pa'i gnyis par ye shes mkha' 'gro lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i sngags 'dir bstan oṃ badz+ra ḍā rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ gau rī hūm̐ 'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro/ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī hūm̐ gdol pa mo/ swāhā/ oṃ be tā lī ro langs ma/hūm̐ swāhā/ sngags pas cho gas bsnun pa dang*/ gsad pa dang/ dgug pa dang*/gar byed pa'o/ /oṃ seng ge ma badz+ra siṃ hi ni aṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai stag mo/gri i swā hā/oṃ badz+ra dzaṃ bu wa gdong ma/ke uṃ swāhā/oṃ badz+ra u 'ug gdong*/lu ka s+ya ṛṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyal mo dbang*/rā dzen+d+ri l̥ṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dep+ta te mar me'i rgyal mo dbang*/ dze aiṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tsum 'jib byed ma/bi ni tsu ṣa badz+ra satwa na auṃ swāhā/ oṃ g.yo ldan ma/ badz+ra kaṃ po dzi aṃ 'dis mi gtsang ba la sogs pa bsang ba'ang bya/ swāhā/ oṃ hriḥswāhā/ dbus su ste ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i'o/ / oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /oṃ khaṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ zhabs bsil gyi sngags so/ /oṃ dh+waṃ dh+waṃ dri dang bshos gtsang ma la sogs pa'i sngags so/

/oṃ haḥhoḥhrīḥswāhā phyag sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa'i/rgya chen po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma yā dhi pa dhi hūm̐ dza swāhā/ dgug pa'i sngags so/ /rtsa rgyud le'u drug par btu ba tsam gsungs/ kun spyod le'u bdun par sngags tsam gsung*/ mngon spyod le'u bcu bdun gsungs pa 'dir sngags tshul mi 'dra'o/ / ha hi hu he ho haṃ yan lag drug la dgod pa'i sngags so/ / dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba bya ba thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po ste brgyad pa rdzogs so// //༈ gnas gang du 'bras bu gang zhig 'grub pa ni mngon brjod lnga bcu drug pa dang*/ khrag 'thung zhe gnyis par cha/ gang gi dbang gis mngon du byed pa ni gzhan gyi gdan gyi bzhi par/ bdud rtsi lnga ni ji ltar lags| |zhes sogs dri tshig lnga gsungs pa'i ā li kā li ji ltar lags kyi lan cha/ a bhi dha na'i le'u lnga bcu rtsa drug pa nas 'byung*/ he ru ka mngon 'byung gi le'u zhe gnyis pa na/ gdan bzhi'i gzhan gyi gdan gyi rab byed gsum pa de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dang*| de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mchog gi dngos grub mya ngan 'das nye ba'i rgyu/ pa'i gnas rgyas a bhi tsan dang zer/pa/ /bcom ldan lha yis bshad du gsol/ /kha sna gang du ni|gnas su bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /brgyad drug mngon du byas pas mchog gi dngos grub/ rten g.yo rgyu dang mi mi g.yo ba la gnas pa/ rgyu bcas par a tsin+da zer/ rol/ /cing don mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /tshul ji lta ba bzhin ci rigs nye ba'i rgyu mngon du byas pa/brtags pas sems mchog gi dngos grub mngon du/'dzin pa/ /nga yis bshad par bya yis nyon/ /gnas gang zhig de gong du rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas par rol ces pa/skad sngar

gsungs pa/ /de la/ gsang ba mchog gi dges pa na zhes thams cad a tsin+da ste dar ma zer|bdag nyid rtag tu de dus su/bzhugs/ /de gang na gnas na dkyil 'khor lus shes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ brjod par bya/ /de ni sgo dgu dag tu 'gyur zer sgo bzhi rlung bzhi rgyu ba'i rtsa bzhi/ji skad gsungs la bzhugs/pa'o/ /de'i nang nas dang lte ba'i mdzes spyi/ dbus su rdo rje dang ze 'bru'i bar/pad ka ko la/chen por/ /rtsa gnyis 'dzoms pa'i gnas su dal bar rgyu ba'i rlung gis byang sems nyi zla dbu mar mngon du byas pa mngon par byang chub/ mchog gi dngos grub kun mkhyen ye shes mngon par a tsin+ta rang lus thabs ldan gyi zer/grags/ /gnas rdo rje dang pad+ma'i bar/der mngon du bya ba'i 'bras bu chos sku/ ka ko la gnas pa'i dpa' bo dz+nya na|ni/ /nyon sgrib dri med shes sgrib/dri ma a/rnam par spangs/ /pa ye shes gnyis med chos sku|lus la gnas shing kyang lus kyi nyes pas ma gos pas/nag nog med/ /las kyis lus bcom pas/ de nyid thams cad du snang lus can dus/kun tu rnam par rol/ /pas don mdzad/ spyir bstan/ ji ltar rol zhe na sangs sprul pa'i don mdzad tshul/rgyas kun gyi rdzu 'phrul che/ /so sor phye ste bstan/ gang la ci 'dul du ston rnam par mdzad cing rab tu bsgyur/ /rgyud phyi ma las la lar zer kha cig tu ni byang chub chen po'i sems/ smon pa/ kha cig tu ni ji ltar spyod bzod pa lta bur ston/ pa bsgrub par ston/rjes 'brangs/ /'jug pa/ kha cig tu ni dga' ldan lha rnams las/ /mchog tu yang ni dga' ldan gnas nas lhums su/ bab par gyur pa dang*/ kha cig tu ni ltums nas/bltams pa rnam dag cing*/ kha cig tu ni khab nas gsal 'byung dang*/ kha cig tu ni byang chub shing drung du gshegs par ston|chen por mchod/ kha cig tu ni bdud las 'dul ba ston/mchog tu rgyal/ kha cig tu ni tho rangs/byang chub mngon byang chub/

kha cig tu ni chos kyi/'khor lo rab tu bskor|kha cig tu ni phas kyi rgol ba dang*/ /lhan cig chos kyis tshar ni gcod pa'o| kha cig tu ni/dngos grub kun gyi/dbang phyug kha cig tu ni dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum las rnam par gdug pa can 'dul ba'i don du khro bo'am khams gsum rnam rgyal du bstan|rgyal/ kha cig tu ni dpag bsam shing mchog kun/ /ci 'dod pa 'byung bar bstan|dngos grub dbang phyug bla na med pa nyid/ /de ltar sprul pa sna tshogs mdzad kyang chos sku las ma g.yos/la sogs mtha' yas mchog /a bhi dha nar du mar snang bar bstan zer|sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/kun bdag mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ sdom pa ni/ /gzugs kyi sku dngos dang cir yang ma grub pas/ ngar dngos med rnam par grol/ /de lta bu'i mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa de phyir gti mug yongs su spangs/ /1gzhan gyi gdan gyi rab byed bzhi pa dang cha mthun par bstan 2gang gi dbang gis mngon du byed pa dri tshig lnga yod pa las bzhi pa ā li kā li ji ltar lags kyi don ā lis byang sems bskyed pa'i rten ā li bung ba zhes tsi tra/byar brjod/ /bo la la bya ste a trig ta ste dpe med ā nan+da ste dga' ba/ la ti gṛh+na ste len pa pos so/ /yig don no/ /de nyid bung bas me tog 'jib pa bzhin bo las shu kra 'jib/ bung ba bh+ra ma ra ste bh+ra ma 'khrul pa 'joms pa'i rten yin pas so/ /bung ba rdo rje 'jigs de nyid gnyis med rtogs pa'i rten yin pa'i phyir rtog pa 'jig pas so/ /byed nyid/ /ni khu ba ste ā nan+da dga' ba la gṛh+na ste len pa ā li nam mkha'i sa go 'byed pa ltar byang sems kyis kyang bde ba'i go 'byed/mthas gtugs sa rgyan ces pa sa ri su ka na kun tu bde ba/ ā nan+ta zhes pa'i skad gyi byings la 'chi khar rten te byang sems 'di kun tu bde ba 'ching bas na mthar thug pa'o/

/par/ /sems can rnams skye zhing 'byin pa'i skabs 'byed/chos rang mtshan 'dzin pas na sems can/ky-i dbyings byang sems/kyi ste 'dzin cing gso bas na/rang bzhin las// rtag tu dgos med kyi bya ba la 'jug pa so so skye bo rgyur dus rtag tu dgos pa med par lo ka la rgyug cing 'jug pa so so skye bo'o/ /bcas mi dgos med la mi 'jug pas rtogs ldan/rgyu gsang gsang ba thabs shes gnyis med so skyes mi shes pas so/ /de'i rnam pa can gyi sems ni blo'o de gang la yod pa gsang blo can te sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad do/ /blo 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi lnga phung po zhar la byang sems kyi gnas bstan/khams 'byung ba bzhi/ dang skye mched yul drug gi dwangs ma/dang*/ / dbang po kun gyi mig la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'byung ba/bdud rtsi dang*/ /so skye bud+dha byang sems thams cad chos dbyings byang sems las byung lus rnams thams cad yang na ā nan+ta sa ha dzar drangs| skye ba byang sems las/nyid/ /gong gi gnas de phyir mngon du byas pa'i brgyad drug po/ thams cad nas byang sems/bkug nas ni/ /a wa dhu tir thim phyir rdo rjer song ngo*/ /rtsa yi ā li|sbubs las te byang sems bo la las pad+mar dbab pa'o/ /su thim par bya/ /de nas ā li dang bung ba rnams kyi rnam grangs su bstan/ da ni shes rab kyi rnam grangs su ston/ gang gis dbab ce na 'jigs byed rdo rjepad+ma sbyor ba/'i sgra yis ni/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor las byang sems rdzogs/rdzas don dam pa'i byang sems/las ni/ /thabs shes sbyor ba las byung ba'i byang sems de nyid yi ge hūm̐ gi bdag nyid du byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir thabs shes gnyis ka'i thig le'i steng du hūm̐ bsam ste de la thim pas rlung gi bdun pa sa/dang me dang bdun ha/pa'i don// rdo rje can sa ha'i zla tshes su/gyi sa bon sbyar/

/thad sor brtan na suṃ hūm̐ du rtogs/ zla tshes steng du thig le u/sgra yis yang dag mnan/ /pas hūm̐/ hūm̐ de las bdud rtsi char gyi rgyud 'dzag pas/ zhes brjod par bya/ /dbyings su brlab pa/ dbyangs kyi dang sogs sa bon a ni/ / yig 'bru rnams kyi dam pa yin pas/ bdud rtsi lnga de yi 'byung ba lnga byin gyis rlobs pa'i ye shes lnga zla ba'i steng du a bsams la de la thim pa las de dbyings su brlab/dbus su bzung bar bya/ /1ka ko la bde ba len pas so 2kā li ji ltar lags kyi lan kā li la la ti grih+na/ kā li me tog kun tu mnan// zer|zhes pa rdo rje can gyi me tog mnan zhes par sbyar te/ mnan zhes pa chos kyi dbyings la bde ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin bzhugs pa'o//me tog nyi mas 'byed pa ltar/ shes par da ru ma'i rdo rjes kha 'byed pa/bya/ /he las khu ba'i rnam pa bcom ldan 'das ces gsungs me khu ba ste ka ko lar/ tog rdo rje can gyi chos sku'i gnas khu ba/lus/ /te byang sems de chos sku'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ /dang la ma mo sa dang kun gyi ma zhes zer/kun gyi sa gzhi dang 'dra/rnams ngan bde thams cad/ ka ko la de sems can gyi rten du gyur pa dang bskyes pas kyi/ /byang sems/ bde ba kun byang sems dang po/la 'khor ba thabs kyis zin ma zin gyi bye brag gis 'khor 'das/ bskyed par 'gyur/ /bde ba yang kā li 'dra ba'i don gyi ye me long lta bu la sogs pa nyid sdug bsngal gyi gdung ba sel ba bcu/ shes chu bo rgya mtsho 'di/ /de gnas su gyur pas chos kyi dbyings/ bha ga shes rab 'dod chags la sogs pa rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas rnams te 'byung ba lngas gang ba'i chu srin gyis gang ba dang 'dra/chu rgya mtsho/ srin spros bral shes pa ste bde ba de'i gnas chos dbyings la btags na shes rab/ dang dbyangs kyi nyas/ /gang ba dang dra ba/ rdor pad sbyor gnyis zhu bde 'dres pa'i lhan skyes ā li kā li'i ngo bo/med ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/

/'di ni 'dam skyes te pad+ma'o/ /dbus ni de'i snying po'o/ /ni karmā mu dra 'dam skyes te pad+ma/ gyi dbus su ni/ /bde ba la nye bas thabs kyi rnam pa'i bde ba bskyed pa'i kha kha mu kha/myu gus pad snying du gyur pas/ ni/ /de nyid ban me togadhu lta bur dhū tī kha/bye ba nyid| |khu ba sbrang rtsi dang ni rak+ta/bdud rtsi'i bha ga na/ gnas/ /rak+ta kā li'i ngo bor ston kā si h+la/li bdud rtsi byang sems/nyid kyi yang*/ /de nyid chu ltar 'dzag pas/chu dang dar mo ta ya gang 'pho/me tog bu tsha la sogs pa bskyed pa nye bas/ nang du 'khor/ /byang sems la brten te lus bskyed bdud si h+la/rtsi 'ang yin la chu'ang yin pas/chu yi cho ga mchog /bu tsha la sogs pa bskyed pas/ he las/ reg pa sra ba'i chos kyi ni/ /sra ba gti mug chos zhes sogs 'byung gnyis las thabs kyis zin ma zin gyi bye brag gis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis kachu ni skye bar 'gyur| |dang po zer gong nye rgyu dngos la gsum kun byang sems ye shes lngar bstan pa/ byang sems 'byung ba lngar bstan/ du byang sems/bdud rtsi dang ni gzhi mthun bya/ chu/ /yig 'bru lngar ye shes lngas byin gyis rlabs pa mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ rab tu rgyas bshad las/ dang po ni thabs shes gnyis ka'i byang sems lnga nang tshan 'byung ba lnga/yi bdud rtsi lnga'i/bdag nyid du ni gsungs/ /de nyid bstan pa me ni bskyod pa las drod skye bas/tsha ba nyid yin te/ /tsha ba me yin te zhes sbyor/rig

cha reg ja pas reg na dro bas me yin te/ /du ba ltar snang rlung yin no/ /zhu ba'i rang bzhin chu yin te/ / gzugs su gnas pa sa yin no/ /rlung ni du ltar g.yo/bar blta/ /'dzag pa dang snum pa chu ni gsher ba'i dngos po ste/ /sa ni sra ba sa ru/gzugs su blta bar bya/ /shes par bya bas na ye shes 'byung ba bzhi nam mkha' ste go 'byed pa'i las byed pas/rdo rjes lnga pos/byin brlabs pas/ /bzhi po de zhu ba la gnas pa la byin gyis rlabs zer/ 'byung ba lnga po rigs/rnam pa lnga ni bdud rtsi lnga/rab tu bskyed/ /lnga po de sangs rgyas lnga ru ji ltar bskyed ce na yang de nas sgo nas yi ge dgos ye shes lngar byin gyis rlabs/ni chu ni ku ni ma lus pa ste/ ma lus pa ni kā pā la ste/ ka la ni cha shas te tsan+d+ra'o/ /pa'i sgra pa ha de sa dang zla tshes lhan cig dngos su gsum bstan/ byang sems zhu mi bskyod|kun gyi dbyibs/ /su dgod 'byung ba bzhi la yig 'bru bzhis byin gyis rlabs pa/de bzhin me la k+ṣa dgod/yis da k+ṣa ya to/zad par zad byed de snang mtha'/ byed/ /de bzhin rlung la yuṃ dgod/yang rtag don grub/pa yi/ /bde ba nam mkha'i rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid/ byang sems sgra bcas su drangs ba/ 'di ni pad+ma'i 'byung gnas nyams dga' la ngang pa'i tshogs 'du zhes bya ba 'byung*| sa dang mtshungs pa dpang po zer/ ni dpang sangs rgyas rnams sangs rgyas pa'i dpang po sa'i lha mo yin pas sa la yang*/po'i gzugs can ma/ /hūm̐ nam mkha'i sa bon/gi glu yi mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed tsa na tshogs 'khor byed tsa na glu blang ba/ rnam pa yis/ /rnal 'byor glu don la brgyad/ma gzhan gdan gnyis pa/kun mnyes par don dam byang sems/ byed/ /chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid kyi don byed mi nus pa'i phyir kye rdo rje zhes bos pa'o/ /rdo mtha' bral du bstan pa/rje yan lag badz+ra hūm̐ gyur pa las hūm̐/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas sems can gyi don la dges kye mchog tu dga' ba'i gtso bo shin tu stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin dor cig pa'o/ /pa'i mthus/ /don de'i nus pa/ lo tsa na shan ye/spyan shalha/ shes/ chos/ sangs rgyas/gyis sems can gyi don la spyan dang sha yir zhu zhes gsung ngo*/ /sgrub po la gzigs khyod stong pa med par 'jig rten thams cad kyang stong*/ de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi mthong bar bya ba'i phyir bzhengs shig pa'o/ /par mdzad pa spu'i bu ga re re nas kyang byin gyis rlobs/ yin/ /'dis mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' bral/ yi a k+ṣa ra mi 'gyur ba ste gnyis med ye shes so/ /ge'i dngos po'i rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin/ni/ /a kha ru bha ru ba ha ru lhan skyes ye shes rang bzhin gyis mi 'gyur bar khyod sgoms shig pa'o/ /1pa'i sa bon haṃ dgod rnam snang 2bha wa a bha wa bi dza ye lhan skyes gnyis med stong pa nyid kyis bshig pa'o/ /stong gnyis med ye shes nyams su myong ba'i dus nyid na/par rol pa nyid kyis ni/ /dngos po thams cad/ shu n+ya sa ma ye stong nyid kyi ye shes so/ /de bas dngos dang dngos med dor zhig dngos dang dngos med kyi rtog pa|rnam spangs pa/ /sa/ 1gnyis med ye shes 2'dis 'khor ba'i mtha' bsal to 3ma dza bi dza ne a e dbu ma'i tshul gyis lhan skyes rdzogs pa'i byang chub shes pa'o/ /snying po yang ni mngon du bya bar dz+nya na| 'tshal ba nyid/ /sems can ma de'ang brjod du med pa'i phyir gsung*/lus bhañj-i a a kha ru sa'u ā li kā li yi ge ngag tu bzlas pa de choms shig pa'o//pa yi bsam pa dang*/ /rdzogs par bya ba| brjod pa'i yi a she ka'i rtsi nar se ye/ge thams cad gzhom gang gzhoms na yi ge lnga bcu rnams kyi mgo chod cig pa'o/ /par gyis/ /brjod pa dang bral ba/ rnal 'byor gyi thabs kyi rtogs tshul gnyis gnyis dan+ta a la ga na dzo u 'khyud pa'i rnal 'byor pas bdag gi rnal 'byor ma rnams dang lhan cig rnam pa med cig pa ste tā ra la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad la 'dod pa spyod cig pa'o/

/yab yum rdor pad kyi kun tu ru 'khyud pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /shu kra chu rnams kyi ni dgos pa sā li la ka dzi ya ye rol pa'i rgyus 'dod pa spyod ces pa'o//can/ /don du gnyer bas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa| de'i dgos pa de ni gnyis med pa ra mi ta/chos ni yab yum zhal sbyor/thob pa chos bdag med pa thugs su chud/na/ /1mu khi bi la i gang zhe na bdag cag rnal 'byor mas thar pa thob pa'o 2dharmā ad+yad srub pa'i ā li kyai gtso bo bdag po gcod pa'i phyir chos gnyis med pa byang chub kyi sems blud cig pa'o| |gang gis she na/ bdag rnal 'byor mas thar pa thob pa'o 3phyag rgya rigs lnga las grol ba thob pa'i dang po las bstan thar pa yang ni thob pa nyid/ /rnal 'byor gyi lam gyis gol ba 'khor ba'i bde bas de'i don gsungs pa su ha snar tsi ma ho i tha mal pa'i bde bas 'khor ba thams cad rmongs pa'o/ /rmongs pa la/ /te zhen pa/ 'khor ba las grol ba yang ni mu stegs la sogs pa dang sangs rgyas can de rnams kyi thar pa spangs pa'i phyir dmyal ba la sogs par sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /spangs de rnams kyi don mdzad pas gzhan don zhes bha wa pa 'chad/pa nyid/ /mu kha ba bi dza a i ste nyan thos ltar mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas/ sku gsung thugs thams cad stong pa'i yang dag pa'i lam rtogs pa chos sku'i rang bzhin/rang rtog pas sarba shū n+ya swa bha ba ha bi dza yo ni thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa'o/ /bzhin du shes pas 'khor bar mi gnas/las// rnal ma te na tsi li ye rnal 'byor pa'i gzhung lugs kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gcig gis sku ji srid nam mkha' mi 'gyur bar sgeg par byas te sbyor ba 'dis spyod par bya zhes sbyar ro/ /'byor ma yi don byed|sngags la brten te yid kyi skyob pas/kyis rol/ /pa ni gar byed pa brtson/rnal byang sems rtog pa gzugs/'byor ma ni mu dra/lnga ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin yin zhes pa'o//po rnams/

/pañja bi dzo i ni bud+dha ta twa/sangs rgyas a la kha a yi sems can thams cad de'i rang bzhin te de rnams kyi gzugs su yid la gnas te zhes pa'o/ /de lnga'i dngos grub/nyid mtshon pad ta ci zhe na/par bya/ /de rnams kyang sgyu sprul pa sna tshogs kyis don mdzad|mar sa ba ma ye ba hu yi ha ru ya rnam pa mang po rnams kyi sgyu ma nyid rnam pa mang po'i gzugs de rnams so/ /gnas pa du ma rnams/ /sna satwa ba sa tsi a i sems can rnams smin par bya'o/ / tshogs gang la ci 'dul de la der bstan pa/gzugs kyis sems can smin/ /par byed/ stong nyid ye shes mngon du rdo rje badz+ra pu ri sa dza ha sems can rnams kyi 'khor ba'i nyes pa rdo rjes gzhom par bya'o| |brkyang pa'i dgos pa ni/ /de'i thugs su chud/ sems can gyi chos kyi rmongs dharmā bi ha ho yi ya/ ci'i phyir zhe na gsungs pa/ bya ba ma yin pa byed pas te ma yin pa'i chos zhe sdang la sogs pa 'dongs pa rnams bsad par bya'o/ /pa bral bar byed/ /rnal de bas na yang dag lam la gus|'byor dzo i ni mu khe a i sbyor ba gang gis thar par 'gro ba thob pas dbang phyug la sogs pa kla klo'i chos rnams dor cig ces dgongs so/ /ma yi thar par byed/ /rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa la bya snying po chos la phyag na ma ha su ru bha mu shin tu snying po chos stong pa dang snying rje'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi chos de la phyag tshol zhig pa'o/ /tshol cig /glu'i dgos pa rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi glu 'di rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag nyid las si ti/skye bar 'gyur ba zhes/'di bka' hūm̐ ring po zer/stsal to/ /dgu pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bskyed pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o|| ||rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u bco brgyad pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i gzhan gyi gdan gyi rab tu byed pa gsum pa nas 'byung ba dang cha mthun par bstan gtor gzhan gdan gsum par ha ho hri rtog med kyi klo ka lan gtor ma byin gyis rlabs pa ma'i las chog ji lta bar/

/rdo rje snying po 'khor bcas thams cad/gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /maṇ+ḍal khru gang tsam gyi tshad du ni/ /tsan+dan/ dmar po dri yi dkyil 'khor dgu/ bya/ /kha dog dkar pos dkyil 'khor/ phyi der gru bzhi par byas la der re mig dgu dang ldan pa'i zlum po byas la le tshe dgu la'ang ye shes kyi lha tshogs/ phyi ma brgyad la zhing skyong chung ma dang bcas pa bskyed/ rol tsan+dan dmar po'am gur gum/gru gsum bya/ /'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa dang mchod yon dang*/mchod pa lnga/ sogs kyi/rim gro ra bya ba|dang*/ /gtor ma'i rgyu nya dang las dang po pa sems brtan thob gnyis/ gnas/ dus/ rgyun khyer par |yo byad/ sha chang*/ grogs/ thob la ma nyams pa/ cho ga bsod nams dang ye shes kyi mtsho ste/ dgos pa/gnas khang brgyan| mchod gtor bsham/ dbyug sngon gsol gdab/ nang 'jug sha sogs sgog tsong*/ bza' ba dang*| |'bru'i chang dang bur shing la sogs pa'i chang*/myos byed mchod par/ spro ba yang*/ / mchod pa dang gtor ma sogs g.yon du nye bar dgos pa kun/ /g.yas pa dag tu chu yi mchod yon/ snod/ /mdun du mchod yon dbul ba'i bzed zhal/ dag gi snod/ /a mri ta rdzas ni 'di dag thams cad rnams/ /bdud rtsi lnga dngos su blug pa'o/ /yis yang na byin gyis brlabs pas sbyang bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag gnyis pa/ting 'dzin nam/ / phyag bcu drug pa yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /las kyi cho ga gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa'i lag len/mthong ba yi/ /sngags dang oṃ ku ru ku ru ye sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūm̐ swāhā/ phyag rgyas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sprel te mdzub mo gnyis sbrel la/lha dgug par bya// me so sor dri yis byugs pa dang*//so sor me tog gtor ba dang*/ /sor sor bdug pas bdug pa sogs// so so'i sbyor bas dbul bar bya/ /tog dmar po bdug pa sogs/ /dri la sogs pa dbul bar bya/

/yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ me gseb tu a las thod pa oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i pad+ma'i rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa/snod/ /lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de nyid khyad par las| |ye shes lcags kyu'i dam tshig bdud rtsi la/rab dbye bas/ /ye shes kyi bdud rtsi yid kyis thams cad dgug pa'o/ /mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyai bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi lcags kyu snang ba'i grangs/dur gsungs pa de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang po skye rgu'i bdag ba glang gi mchod sbyin pas ba glang*/ por khyi/brjod/ /de bzhin gnyis hasti glang po che/par sgrol ma nyid/ /gsum pa la ni rta|rab mchog brjod/ /bzhi pa la na ra/ni mang glang po/po skyes/ /lnga pa mi/la ni stobs ba glang gishes bya/ /de'i staing du rigs lnga rnams kyi sngags bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ 'di dag |ye shes lnga yis rab dbye bas/ /ye shes chen po lnga po 'di/ khyod la phan pa'i bsam pas bshad/ /ye shes kyi snang ba'i/lcags kyu lnga'i/ rab dbye bas/ / gtor ma'i las rnams lcags kyu'i steng du/kun la sbyar bar bya/ /las bzhi gal te las la phan 'dod pas/ /rnal 'byor ma ni thams cad la/ /mthe bo'i thor mas so sor dbul/ /de 'og rang gi dngos po yis/ /bdag nyid la ni bsam par bya/ /lce rtse thig le steng du yang*/ /blo dang ldan pas gnas gsum mchod/ /gdan bzhi las rnal 'byor ma kun tshim par bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan|la dga' ba zhen/bar mi bya zhing*/ /longs spyod la ni sbyar mi zhi ba la sogs pa'i ched du longs mi spyad/bya/ /sems can don rgyu rnal 'byor pas/ /bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te mchod pa bya ba'i bsam pas/mchod pa thams cad rab tu brtag /dbyangs kyi bcu gsum o/las ma/byung ba/ /gang zhig de'i steng du/zla ba de rab grags/ /de yi dbus su sa bon gyi/ /bdag nyid/ ā li bcu drug phrag gnyis g.yon bskor/kā li sum cu rtsa gnyis g.yas bskor/mnyam sbyor bas/

/de'i nang gi sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas lha kun de nas tshim par bya/ /rlung gi 'bud pa me/ 'bar ba nyid dang ni/ khyad par du yang rtog pa/bkol ba nyid/ /shel gyi gzugs 'o ma lta bu/kyis skyed bya zhing*/ /de nas 'og gi ha ho hrīḥ'i don 'dir sbyar bar bya de phyir dam tshig dang ye shes kyi 'dres/thams cad brtag par bya/ /ka pā la de yi dbus nas mtheb srin gyis/blangs nas ni/ /de nas rang gibadud rtsi myang bar bya| |lha dang rang la lhag ma ste phyi rol 'byung po lhag ma la sogs dngos po kun/ /de ltar lha mchod rang gi lce la bdud rtsi myang ba'i lhag ma de gtor ma la blugs la gtor ma de byin gyis brlabs te phyi rol dkyil 'khor tshim par bya/ /lag par g.yon pa'i cha yi gtor ma'i/snod dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la'o/ /ni/ /zhes pa cha gnyis su bgos la g.yon dang g.yas su bzhag la g.yon lha la/ g.yas 'byung po la'o/ /'byung po g.yas pa'i khro bo sdigs mdzub phyogs skyong la|bstan par bya/ /rkang pas g.yas pas g.yon pa/ mnan cing mig steng du blta/ spyi bor pheṃ gyi rnam pa 'byung*/ /bar bsam/ bar chad thams cad zhi ba la zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa la khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang*/ /tshogs rdzogs pa la yar gyi ngo yi bcu pa la/ /mchod pa 'i rdzas/mchod pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /mgron dgug pa'i sngags oṃ 'jig rten las 'das pa/shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ri dang ri sul dang ni zer ri bo dang ni 'bab chu ri bragadang*/ /phug zer khyim dang grong gi ngos grong bar| dang ni/ /bzhi mdo/ stong pa'i khyim dang khyad par du/ /zer/zhing dang khong stong*/ grong ni stong pa dang*/ /chu yi gnas dang skam pa'i gnas/sems can la brten pa/snod dang thang son dang*| |de bzhin ma mo'i khyim du ni/ /zer chu la yang ni khyad par du'o/ /1zhing skyong gnyis 2de dag kyang gang zhe na 3sngar gyi brgyad la dgod/

phyogs skyong brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la bkug nas bstim pa'o| |drag po nag sngon po/po byang du/ drag po che/ /nag po zer/ nub tu lha mo yang ni lha sbyin|mnyam dkar/par brten pa dang zer/ gnas/ /lhor nag po dmar po/ mer gtsigs pa nag ser/ dbang ldan 'jigs su sngo/ rung*/ /dkar dmar dga' las bden bral/ 'das dang log dkar ser/ rlung 'dren ma/ /tshogs bdag 1rgan byed ma zer 2de re re la yum bzhi bzhi gdol phur pa/pa tsa muṇ+ḍi/mo dang 'jigs bzhi po dkar mo/pa'i gzugs/ /g.yon drag mo/ rgyab lha mo dka' mi sdug ma/ 'jigs ma zer bzlog u ma de wi/thams g.yas su/cad du| |shar rgyal ma dang ni kyang*/rnam rgyal nyid/ /nub mi thub ma dang lho/gzhan mi thub| |nag shar/mo bzang ma byang*/nag mo che/ /nub nag sbom rnal 'byor lho/mi'i dbang mo/ /zla shar/ba mo dang byang*/'jigs pa dragamo/ /nub gdug pa gdang mo zer/ can dang lam 'phyang ma/ lho pa kī/ /sum shar/ cu rtsa gsum byang*/dbang phyug ma/ /kaṃ po dzi g.yo ldan 'phrog byed ma/ byang mar me nub 'jib 'o/ byed lho/ ma/ /de rnams ni grong du gnas pa rnal 'byor ma/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ba'i thod pa/ gzugs ngan thod pa/gtsigs pa nyid/ /thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba can| |rdzu 'phrul mthu chen yan chad mchod pa lnga lag na thogs pa/lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /la sogs pa ming dang mthun pa'i mtshon bya 'dzin pa/lag na dgra s+t+wa can dang*/ral gri can/dang*/ /rdo rje lag ma gzhu yi lag /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying po lnga/de nyid lnga/che/ /las bzhi/rnams rjes su grub par byed/ /lha gang gis 'gugs par byed pa bstan rnal 'byor ye shes kyi lha bcu gsum|dkyil 'khor dpa' bo nyer bzhi/ rgyal mo phag mo nyer bzhi/che/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i dbang phyug he ru kagatso/ /te ra dam/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen dang*/ las/ /nyon mongs pa'i skyon med snying rje stong pa gnyis med/rnal 'byor chos sku skye med las bde ba chen po|'byin pa mo/

/mgron thams cad/ he badz+ra rdo rje rang nyid he badz+ra phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/dbang phyug bka' lung 'dis/ /thams cad nas ni mgron/ thams cad dgug /gtad pa'i oṃ ka ka kan dha na ba ba ban dha/ kha kha khā da na/ sarba duṣ+taṃ ha na ha na/ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mu ka s+ye shan+tiṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa dza swāhā/de nas kha khas btab bo/ /sngags kyi gong du 'di 'ongs bdud rtsi'i bsam gtan dmigs nas ni/ /bdud rtsis mgron gyi/kha ni yang na maṇ+ḍal a mri tas byin gyis brlabs la khar blugs te kha phru btab/dgang bar bya/ /las sogs pa/bsams nas 'jig rten dang 'das pa'i/rnal 'byor las kyi go 'phang mngon bsam ste/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma bsgom na// zer|dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma ni bsgom par bya/ /de rnams mnyes pas las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /gtor ma phul ba'i rjes la tshogs byin rlabs ston ha 'di gong du bdud rtsi byin gyis rlabs pa'i 'phror yang sbyar/ yang na de ltar gtor ma'i mchod pa byas nas de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams la tshogs kyi mchod pa byed pas de'i byin rlabs ston te rgyas pa byed na gong gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs dang 'di gnyis ka bya/ mdor bsdus te byed na 'di kho na byas pas chog go/yis bdud rtsi'i/ kha dog ngan pa/'phrog par byed/ /rnam snang hos ni dri ngan pa/ni 'jig par byed/ /ak+ṣo hrīḥs ni nus pa/brtson 'grus ngan pa/'joms par ni/ /rim pa 'di ni brjod par bya| |mthe bo'i sor mo sa nyid de/ /srin lag dag ni ri rab bo/ /srub pa'i stobs kyis bdud rtsi yi// chu ni rnam gsum shes par bya/ /rnam gsum lan gsum brjod pas ni/ /gsum gyis lha rnams tshim par bya/ /mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/pad+ma ha ni/dbang phyug yin pas kha dog ngan pa bcom ste/ 'od dpag med gzugs rnams ni zer/gser mdog /ltar dri ma med cing dag par bsam|gzi nganaX pa/brjid ngan pa dri chu rnam ho/snang gser gyi kha dog gzi brjid can//zer/bai ro tsa na dang*/

/rnam par dag pa/rdo rje mi bskyod pa rnam par dag pas des ro ngan pa thams cad bcom|dbang hrīḥn/ phyug myang ba ni/ /lag na rdo rje zhes bos/lha gsum sku gsung thugs gsum| ha ho hrīḥdag /rnam pa pad+ma'i dbang phyug gzugs mdzes gser gyi mdog /dri chu'i ngo bo/shin tu rnam snang mdzad/ /myang ba rdo rje'i dbang phyug phyag rdo rje/ /lhagasum rnam gsum du ni bsgom par bya/ gsum du shesapar bya// rab byed bzhi pa'i skyes pa'i thod chen kha skong 'dir de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa la las kyi rdo rjes skabs phye nas nang du zhugs te slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas phyag byas nas thal mo sbyar nas gnang ba nod pa la slob dpon gyis gnang ba byin pa ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dus tsam na/ni chos rnams bza' ba sogs/ bzang por ltos/ /'du ba rnams la lhan skyes yin nam ma yin snyam pa'i/the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ lha'i rang bzhin de thams cad lhan skyes su gcig pas/cig pa nyid du zo/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni de nas gnang ba/sbyin/ /las kyi rdo rjes dam tshig gi zas drangs pa ni rol bcas mchog tu rjes bskor bas/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag pa yis/ /'dod pas bskor bar byas ma ltos zhes sogs brjod la drangs shing bstab la len pa pos kyang de dang 'dra|ba'o/ /der tshogs pa rnams rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji ltar lhar/rab tu myur bar 'jug /bde bar gshegs pa'i chos rnams kyi zer/chos ni rin thang med/ / 'dod chags rin thang med pa ste zer/ dri ma rnam par bsal/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs//gus pas de la phyag gnyis med ye shes rtogs par gyis shigatshol cig/ tshogs kyi slob dpon las kyi rdo rje'i bar bstab pa dang blang ba'i tshigs bcad brjod/ tshigs bcad 'di gdan bzhi las mar sbyar nas yod/ yar sbyar yang rung bsam tshigs bcad 'dis ni blangs bar bya/

/bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la yang dag spyod pa'i de nyid 'di/ /tha mal pa'i rtog pa'i dri ma dang bral bas gtsang sbra'o/ /gtsang sbra kun tu rnal 'byor pa'i/ /yon bdag ji ltar bde ba zhes byar brjod/ /de'i rjes la bza' btung gzhan nam glu gar byed na dgu pa dngos nas 'byung bas der sbyar/ phyag rgya ltar ka ko la a las pad+mar sa ha dza mngon sum du bya ba'i 'du shes/yan lag phan min bde ba'i lugs zer/yan lag u ltar bo la rdo rjer/bde gsol btab| |gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /sgyu ma 'dis ni rnam par brgyan| |lhan skyes sgyu ma lta bu/dngos po tha mal pa'i rtog pa las/rnam grol phyag tshol zhig/ lhan skyes rtogs par byas la/rdo rje dril bu'i sgra dang ni zer/ rnams kyis/ /rang dga' ci 'dod pa'i/ bkra shis glu ldan pas/ /phyag rgya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar byas nas/ / snying kha ru ni bzung bar bya/ /de nas sems can kun sogs la/ /smon lam rnams ni gdab par bya/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa|'gyur ba/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /ma rgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba dag dgrol bar bgyi/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos las gsungs pa/bya ba'i dngos/ /po/de lta bu ni yang dag brtags/ /le tshe dbus ma la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi lha la bstims pa'i ye shes pa rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /g.yon pa snying khar bzhag par bya/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas ni/ /sa la bzhag nas rang gnas su/ gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ at+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ swāhā dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/phyis ni bdag gi dbugs kyis nang du rngub pa'i dus su/ni/ /bdag gi lus la thim par bya| |skad cig gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gi dngos pos bstim pa dang*/ mchod par bya/ /oṃ sarba duṣ+ta gṛh+na gṛh+na gats+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/

se gol gsum gtogs nas phyi rol gyi lha rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su/gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /dgu pa las gtor ma'i mchod pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //brtag gnyis le'u bdun pa dang*/ drug par bris sku dang glegs bam gyi don gsungs pa'i bris sku'i gzhi dang 'bri mkhan la sogs pa gsal bar bshad kyang*/ 'dir sngon du bsnyen pa ni bde mchog nyung ngu'i nyer dgu pa dang nyer gsum pa phyogs gcig tu byas te/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang bral na gtsang sbra dang*/ lha'i nga rgyal dang*/ dag bya dag byed kyang 'di yin no zhes pa cha/ des he badz+ra kha/ glegs bam cha'o/ / gsang ye shes kyi snang ba spyan la sogs pa'i/ bha ga der zag med kyi bde ba myong bas/ba'i chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang*/pad+ma de nyid du zag med kyi bde ba myong bas/bde ba can/ /rgyal ba lnga thams cad kyi/bdag nyid la dus dang de bzhin nyid yin pas rtag bzhugs la/ /gsang ba chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang*/la ni rnam gnas nas/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /snod min la sbas pa'i mchog la/bde ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i/dngos spyod yul/ /1te rgyud smin pa snod du rung ba'i/ 2de gang zhe na/ bde gshegs kun gyi mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis sogs|dkyil 'khor dang*/ /rta mgrin sogs/khro bo rnams dang sgrol ma sogs/lha rnams la| |thams cad lha khyod kyis gsungs na/ /ji ltar nang la rnam gnas pa/ /de nyid bla med bdag gi 'tshal bas/ /da dung bdag la the tshom mchis/ /gang gi cho gas bris sku dang*/ /glegs bam yang ni bri bar bya/ /lha lags 'di dag mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dad pa'i/ bdag nyid che la/lang tsho la bab pa spyod pa/dal ba dang*/ / lus kyi shargyas shing gtsang dang mi gtsang ba'i/rnam par/ rtog pa/ med pa dang*/ /ri mo mkhan la khro med lkog 'phyas med pa dang*/

/shin tu ri mo/cha phra de la/mkhas spro dang*/ /ri mo las bzod dang de la/dad pa snying rjer ldan/ /de ltar gyur pa'i ri mo mkhan/ /de'i steng du yang yang de dag mi ldan yang dam tshig dang ldan pas bri sems/na dam tshig can gyi yang*// ri mo mkhan gyis bri bar bya/ /rtsa rgyud du dang po nas bsgrub pa'i ras su bshad sgrub pa po dam pas dpa' bo'i ras sam/ ro la dkris pa'i ras sam/ bu btsas pa'i ras sam| khrag chen pos bsgos pa/btsos pa'i ras sam/ bud med kyi me tog gis rab tu bsgrubs pa'i ras rnams la/ sgrol ma dang*/ 'od zer can dang*/ de bzhin du ri khrod ma shing lo can la sogs pa/bri bar bya'o/ /de la 'di'i bri ba'i/cho ga ni nyan thos la sogs pas mi tshor ba'i/gsang ba'i phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas lha'i rnal 'byor la/shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas 'brir gzhug par bya'o/ /skyes pa'i thod par gnas par ji ltar gsungs pa'i kha dog lnga dang*/ si h+la dang ga pur la sogs pa bsres pa dang*/ ro'i skra'i pir gyis 'jigs pa/ bri lci bar zer/bar bya'o/ / bri ba'i dang bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba/po slob dpon gyis lha'i rnal 'byor la/mnyam par bzhag pas las kyi phyag rgya/shes rab ma dang ldan zhing rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang yab yum zhal sbyor dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas yan lag la ni raṃ shu bsam zhing gcer bur gyur pa dang*/ de bzhin du yang lhag ma dang tha mal gyi rtog pa/ma dag pas mkhas pas bri bar mi bya'o/ /kye bcom ldan 'das gal te si h+la la sogs pa bsres pa lags na de'i tshe ji ltar ma dag pa pa mi 'bri ba/ ste ma dag pa yin lags lags/ma dag pas mi 'bri na ci ste si h+la la sogs pas bri zhes rgol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /lhag ma dang ma dag pas mi bri zhes pa ni tha mal pa'i rtog pa lhag ma dang ma dag pas mi bri ste zhes bya ba'i si h+las bsgos kyang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te tha mal pa'i rtog pa dang bral na dga' ba'o/

/pho nya gtsang sbra dang po thams cad bstan pas saṃ bha ra'i le'u nyer bdun pa nas/ste/ /gnyis pa la ni zhi bar ba'i sbyin sreg gi 'dod| |gtsang mi gtsang gi rtog pa bcom na byang sems za ba zer/ snod re re/gcig tu ni zas nyid ni/ /rigs bzang ngan gyi rtog pa bcom nas ku ku ra tsa sogs thams cad zer/gtsang sbra gsum po nyid du gsungs/ /phyi rol rnal 'byor la dga' bas/ /gtsang sbra gsum po|'di dag yang dag brtsams/ /kyang*/rang sems dri ma tha mal pa'i/can gyur la/ / gnas ni 'di yis dad pa gong ma gsum pos/ci zhig dgos/ /tha mal pa'i rtog pa gang drod thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i skyon zer/yang log pa'i chos gnas pa/ /tha mal pa'i bde ba 'dod saṃ bha ra'i le'u nyer dgu pa'i/pa'i don kun sgrub par byed pa'i/'dod pa ni/ /bsam pas sbyar na rnal 'byor pa la gang zhig sdang zer/khyi yi skye gnas brgyar 'gro ste/ /sme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /dper na kha cig mar don gnyer/ /'bad pas chu ni bsrub gyur kyang*/ /mar sar thob par mi 'gyur te/ /lus nyon mongs pa kho nar zad/ / 1de bzhin lhan skyes gyi ting nge 'dzin 'dzin 1tir ti ka'i lha'am karma zer/ 2'du shes gsum gyis zin/ dang lha/mchod pa gnyis byed pa/ma yin pa zer/gtogs par/ /mu dra bsten pa gzhan du bzang mo don med 'gyur/ /'tsho ba'i thabs kyi rgyu yis phyir/ /rnal 'byor gzhan la brten pa nyid/ /he ru ka la thod pas brgyan pa'i 'thad pa dung khyod tir ti kadang nya phyis saṃ bha ra'i le'u so gnyis/mu tig rnams/ /gsum po de dag byed kyi rgyu mtshan du khyer la thod pa smod do zhe na/car mi gtsang ba pha ma'i/rgyu las byung ba nyid zer de la mi smod pa/yin na/ /tshogs khyad par can bsags pa'i phyir chos kyi sku yi lus can gyi//thod pa la ni su zhig smod/ / de smad du mi btub pas na he ru ka la brgyan par rigs so/

/skra'i mchod phyir thogs pa bram ze sogs|dag byed du 'dod/ kyang*/ /de ni dag byed gsha' ma ma yin pas/dam bla na med pa/pa'i chos kyi rim par gsungs/ /pa'i/gtsang sbra lha'i rnal 'byor nyid rtogs pa las dag pas gtsang sbra/he ru ka dpal gnas/ /de phyir kun tu rab 'bad pas/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub pos mchod/ /shin tu bzhin mdzes snying rje can/ /gzugs dang lang tsho skal bzang ma/ /gzugs bzang sgrub pa po la dga'/ /rang gi phyag rgya ras 'dul thig spyan dbye'i bar du/g.yon du bzhag /pir la byin brlabs 'bri mkhan la/ / sa bon lnga las rigs lngar byin te bris sku 'jigs pa ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /de nas yang dag bri bar bya/ /ras 'dul nas bzung te 'jig rten gzhan la mi bstan zhing*/ /ri mo mkhan dang sgrub pos blta/ /glegs bam khyod la bshad bya yis/ /lha mo skal pa chen mo nyon/ /gro ga'am ta la'i 'dab ma la/ /glegs bam sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /chur brgyad zheng du bzhi/sbrang chen snag tsha byas nas ni/ / mi yi rus pa'i smyug gu yis/ /dam tshig can gyis bri bar bya/ /glegs bam dang ni bris sku nyid/ /gal te skal ba med mthong na/ /skye ba 'dir ni dam tshig nyams pas dngos grub/'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol theg pa chen po la/spyod yul min/ / dam tshig ldan pa la/sems dpa' sbyin par bya/ /res 'ga' tsam zhig bstan pa'o// glegs bam lam gyi spyod yul du/ /skra dang mchan khung sba bar bya/ /dam tshig dang ldan pa la/sems dpa' sbyin par bya/ /dgu pa las bris sku dang glegs bam gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //gling bu dang ni rgyud gcig dang*/ /de bzhin rgyud mang rgyud drug dang*/ /sil snyan phyag rgyar bshad pa rnams| |las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub pa'o/ /cha lugs ji bzhin gar byed pas/ /ma rungs par yang 'grub par 'gyur//sil snyan dkrol ba la/yang dag par/sbyor ba'i/mtshan nyid/

/bshad par bya yis lha mo nyon/ /a ra a ra/ dzaiṃ dzaiṃ*/ sma ra sma ra/ tsa ṭa baṃ ho tsa ṭa baṃ ho/ hu lu hu lu/ hūm̐ dza hūm̐ dza/ a la a la/ ṇu hūm̐ ṇu hūm̐/ hraṃ hraṃ hri taṃ/ ghaiṃ ghaiṃ ghaiṃ/ ta ṭa ghaiṃ ghaiṃ ghaiṃ*/ hon+dau hon+do/ ka ka ka ka kau bzhi gsal/ kau baiṃ ke baiṃ ke baiṃ ke badz+ra baṃ/ dz+riṃ dz+riṃ rdo rje gsum snang ba spong*/dz+riṃ*/ bai kai kai bzhi ka la bai sbyor ba'ang yod/kai kai hūm̐/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ ru lu ru lu ru lu hūm̐/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ rdo rje 'dzin rnga'i/pa la sogs sil snyan gyi sgra'o/ /pa'i'o/ / ṭa ki hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gsum ka la ṭak+ki hūm̐ sbyar/ dza dza dza/ 'di 'di la ga ta beṃ zer/ni sems can gyi don la|rol pa'i 'gro ba'o/ /'i sil snyan/ta ḍa ba ta ḍa ba/ ba h+me ba h+me rta mgrin gyi'o/ / sil snyan/ hriṃṣ+tiṃ hriṃṣ+tiṃ hriṃṣ+tiṃ/ ṣ+tiṃ ṣ+tiṃ gsum/ṣ+ti/ཾ gshin rje'i rgyal po'i sil snyan/'o/ /hrī hrī/ / kuṃ hrīṃ kuṃ hrī/ཾ khen+ta/ kheṃ kheṃ kheṃ*/'di bla dpe la med pad+maṃ pad+maṃ hri pad+maṃ pad+maṃ/ triṃ triṃ triṃ triṃ triṃ triṃ hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ*/ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ*/ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ sgrol ma'isil snyan/'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor nas 'byung ba'i/cang te'u'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /badz+ri rdo rje'i shing*/ shir+ṣa rtsa ba dang*/ tsan dan dmar po las byung dang*/ /de kun ma yin pa gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams ni/ /yid la 'dod pa rnams la cang te'u/bya/ /de yi tshad ni bka' stsal pa/ / chur sor bcu gnyis pa dang bcu pa nyid/ kha la sor ni bcu gnyis pa la/drug dang bcu pa la|lnga/ /dgu pa dang ni bcu gcig nyid/ kha la de yi dgu pa la phyed dang lnga/ phyed bcu gcig la phyed dang drug gong ma la/nyid do/ /gzhan pa yi yang rnge'u chung ni/ /thod ka pā la gnyis rgyab sprad pa la bya/pa las ni bskor ba nyid/ /spre'u'i mo/lpags pas g.yogs pa'o|

|de bzhin pags pa/kha sbyar gnyis la ni/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad/dag ni bri bar bya| |bud med khrag gis bri bar bya/ mdzes pa dang*/ /dur khrod skyes pa'i skra las ni| |bkal nas rus pa gnyis rnge'u chung gi kha gnyis po/ ni bcing*/ khyim gyi me tog si h+la/nyid kyis ni/ /sngar bris pa'i pad+ma ka pā la/ ze 'bru gnyis ka la/ /he badz+ra'i dkyil 'khor nyid ni bri bar bya/ /dus mtshan mo lam gyi/bzhi mdo dag tu ni/ /'dug la/rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi mtshams su ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bri bar bya/ /lcags kyu ste der gnas lag pa/g.yon pa'i ngos su ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma che ge mo khug cig ces ji ltar dang po'i ming bzung ba/ khe hūm̐ zhes ni brjod nas ni| |rnga sding chu skyar rkang pa'i rus pas gdab/ /de ltar g.yo ldan ma la sogs// thams cad 'gugs par byed par 'gyur/ /gal te 'ongs par ma gyur na/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro ma kun 'chi/ /nges pa nyid du 'grub 'gyur bas/ /ngas gsungs pa la the tshom med/ /gal te khros pas slob dpon gyis/ /cang te'u brdung bar byed pa na/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro ma rnams/mchi ma 'dzag cing ngu*/ /sgo srung khyod khyod ni dam tshig khro bo sngon pos mdzes/ khyod ni dam tshig la ni sems/ /rin chen rnam bcing dbyig pa ni/ /lag pa yis ni 'dzin mdzad pa/ /dpa' bo skal ldan bdag thongs shig /'khor ba las ni sgrol ba ru/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor ma nang du/ /mkhas pa sgo ni btang du gsol/ /zhes pa las de skad zer ro/ /ga na tsakra'i dus rnal 'byor pa gcig dbyig sngon du bskyed la/ lag na dbyig pa dang*/ ral gri thogs nas tshogs khang gi sgo bsrung bar bya/ de la rnal 'byor la nang du/ 'gro ba'i gsol ba gdab bo/ /gal te tshig 'dis gsol 'debs zhes na nang du btang ngo*/ /ni thams cad kyi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir/dam tshig la ni khro bo sngon pos mdzes/

/dngos grub dang ldan pa'i/phyag na dbyig tho rtse mo la/rin chen bcing pa 'dzin/ /kyai dpal ldan dpa' bo 'du bar 'khor 'khor ba las/sgrol tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'du bas/'khums/ /pas/mkhas mdzes rnal 'byor ma yi nang du'ang bdag thong zhig /maṇ+ḍal tshogs kyi 'du ba bzang po dngos grub kyi rgyu/nyid/ /lha mo skal ba chen mo nyon/ /ga ṇa tsakra'i 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa po/ /gnas gang du bza' ba/zos pas mchog gi dngos grub/'grub 'gyur ba/ /dur khrod ri yi tshang tshing dang*| |rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du yang*/ /yang na dben pa'am bas mtha' ru/ / bza' ba 'di dag yang dag brtsams/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang*/ /mnyam sbyor las rigs drug so so'i mchod pa de bzhin bza' ba bca' ba nyid/ /sgeg mo dang ni na chung dang*/ /myos dang de bzhin bdud rtsi dang*/ /gcig tu dpa' dang 'dod chags sdang*/ /g.yon can bran mo de bzhin no/ /chang ni chang la pad brgyad/sgeg mo ru ni brjod/ /chang ni rab sbrang chang zer/ tu myos pas sbrang rtsi'o//mar brjod/ /bu ram zer gur gum chang ni myos byed gsungs/ / rgun chang dang ni bdud rtsi yin snying po dang ni ro mchog nyid/bdud rtsi rgun chang yin zer/ro mchog dang*| |sangs rgyas kun gyi kla klo yi/ /skad kyis/bdud rtsi lam ni brda/yan lag brgyad| |sing po la dras bskul rgun 'brum bdud rtsi dpa' bo cig /tshwa ni 'dod chags dang sra ba yin nya phyis rtsub pa'i 'dod pa can/ /sing skyur po khu ba g.yon can yin/po bshang bar brjod pa ste/ /tsab dang bran mo kaṃ pa la/sing por brjod/ /de ltar bza' ba sna tshogs dang*/ /chang dang nya dang yang dag ldan/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod skal bzang bas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub/ /a mra sman dang cha mthun/pa na sa/ /rgun 'brum na li ke ra dang*/ /ni zer/a ru mu ga zer/kar la sogs pa yi/ /'bras bu sna tshogs tha dad pa/

/tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbul bar bya/ /'dis ni glu dang phyag rgya dang*/ /nges par gar dang khyad par du'o/ /ka ha she ya glu yi rgya// 'joms pa thams cad rab grub pa'o/ /hi zhes bya ba glu yi rgya/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal bar byed/ /hūm̐ gi glu yi phyag rgya dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab grub pa'o/ /oṃ gyi glu yi phyag rgya ni// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis ci dgar blangs/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /sems can thams cad thar par byed| |he zhes bya ba glu yi rgya/ /thams cad dga' ba bsgrub pa'o//ka ka ka ka ka ka ka ka brgyad/ hi hi hi hi hi hi hi hi hi dguhrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ lnga/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dgu/ hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā bcu gnyis/ i hā hā hā hā hā lnga/ dzāṃ dzāṃ dzāṃ dzāṃ bzhi/ a i a i a i gsum/dzaṃ dzaṃ i gcig /dzaiṃ dzaiṃ i/ dzaiṃ dzaiṃ i gnyis/ i dzaiṃ dzai dzaiṃ/ i te eṃ*/ hi hi hi hi hi hi drugahī hī hī hī hī hī hī hī hī hī hī hī hī bcu gsum/ kadz+dza hi hi/ de ltar kla klos 'di skad kyi/ kun 'dar bar byed pa/nyid/ /he ru ka yi sbyor bas gar/ /phyag rgya nyid kyang khyad par du'o/ /mig gang bltas de ni khu tshur te zer gang phyir yo gi lta stangs phyag rgya/de khu tshur/ /yo gi ni lta mig gi stangs khu tshur rkang pas gar/rkang*/ / sngags kyiji ltar rnal 'byor rig pa las/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spun/rnam par mdzad| |pa ltar bya/sring mo'i bu mo sgyug mo dang*/ /ma dang sring mo yin na yang*/ / de rnams gang bde bas tshim/bar mchod pas na/ /bdud rtsi lnga tshogs kyi snying po bde ba|dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi lnga 'dus pa/ 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig par/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang nas/ /bla ma la dbul skal chen ma| |phyag 'tshal nas ni rang yang btung*/ /pad+ma'i lag pas blangs pa dang*/

/de nyid kyi ni lag pas dbul/ /yang nas yang du phyag 'tshal ba/ /de la sgrub pa po yis bya/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba bya ba sil snyan/ der ston mo/ bza' ba/ glu'i bya ba'i de kho na/ bzhi'i de kho na'i rgyal po ste brtag pa dgu pa'o// //༈ 'bras bu'i rgyu'i sgo/ 'bras dngos dang gnyis/ mnyan/ don dngos/ de lnga/ ring rgyu'i sgo nas 'grub| rgyu rgyud rang bzhin gyi gnas sgo nas 'grub/ nye rgyu'i 'grub/ mchog gyur/ thabs bsten gdams/ thabs de ji srid cig tu bsten pa'i dus so/ /dang po/ dbang sgo 'grub/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyis 'grub| he'i bcu pa dang gnyis pa/ a bhi lnga bcu drug pa/ mngon byung lnga bcu gnyis pa la sogs pa dang*// gzhan yang rnal 'byor chen po mtha' dag gi ste/ la la gsal bar byed/ la la kha bskang ngo*/ /sgrub pa po|rdo rje slob dpon dam tshig la gnas pas/gi /dngos grub/ grub rtags rgyu/lag na rdo rje nyon/ /dang por 'khor lo chen po yi/ /de nyid gang yin zhe na/snying kha yi ni thugs kyi|dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur ba ni/rang gi dbang sogs rgyas pa yi/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi/nang du zhugs pas na/ /rdo rje slob dpon mtshungs gyi phyag rgya chen po/med pa/ /sgrub pos/ 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ / rim pa gnyis kyi don/gang phyir dbang nos te snod du rung bar byas te/ thos pa dang bsam pa la sogs pa/de nyid kyi/ /bsam thos pa'i don/gtan spro ba bsgom/nyid kyi phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon phyag rgya chen por/'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i he ru ka bzhi/snying po sogs| |'bum du bzlas pas rab tu 'grub/ /bskal pa kun gyi sngon grub pas| |gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/slob dpon chen po gdod nas 'grub/ /gdod nas grub pa de ye shes ngos 'dzin gyis rtogs par byas nas bsgom pas cho ga nyams su blang ba/'dis kyang sems can rnams/

/rgyal bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /nye rgyu'i sgo gnyis las thabs gnyis ka'i dbang du byas nas mdor/ phyag rgya gang gis gang 'grub/ rgyas gnyis phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i la kar med ye shes bsgom pa la/spro bar bcas pa rnams/ /lhan skyes/ des phyag rgya chen po thob par bya ba'i bar de nyid gnas shing go cha bgos/ /na/ des dang po phyag rgya chen po pa ra 'grub thams cad mkhyen pas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa lnga'o/ /gang gang gis/ / rigs kyi rab tu dbye ba las/ /phyag rgya gang dang spyan la sogs pa bsten par/gang gsungs pa/ /de dang de mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin na g.yung mo la sogs mā ma kīr byin gyis brlabs pa la brten zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /ni de bsten pas phyag rgya chen po/cho gas blangs/ /de dang de nyid kyis ni bsgrubs/ /gti mug bdag nyid ky-i rnal 'byor pa yin na brda/ nges par ma/ /ngo bo lha mo'am skye gnyis bdag nyid skyes/ /brten byed rnal 'byor pa gti mug rnam par bsam gtan pas/ /blangs nas mngon du spyan du byin gyis brlabs nas bsten na/rnam snang 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la ma ni rig ma dam pa ste/ /gal te pha yis gsang ba'i slob dpon gyis/ sngar bsten kyang*/ /de bzhin de nyid kyis kyang slob ma'i yum gyis kyang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dus su bsten na dngos grub|'grub/ /bde ba chen pos bka' bstsal to/ /yo gi zhe sdang bdag nyid g.yung mor yod/gdol pa ma/ /dam tshig gi mu tra bu mo'i brdas bstan pa/'am gnod spyin bu mo blangs| |mā ma kir bskyed pa de dang snyoms par zhugs pa las zhe sdang rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ /mi bskyod pa ni mngon du 'gyur/ /'dod chags bdag nyid kyi yo gi gar mkhan ngo bo/ ma/ /sring mo'i brda/ yang na/ klu mo lha min dam tshig gi phyag rgya/blangs/ / gos dkar mor bskyed de bsten pas 'dod chags rnam dag bsam gtan pa/

/'od dpag med pa bsgom par 'gyur/ /phrag dog gi rnal 'byor pas/ bdag nyid bzo shes ko lpags bu mo/ma/ /chu 'byung dga' ma'am sring mo yi/ /brda/bu mo yang dag blangs nas ni/ /sgrol mar bskyed de bsten na phrag dog rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ / dpa' bo don yod grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zer nga rgyal rat+na/bdag nyid mna' brda|ma 'am/ /ngo bo rgyal po'i bu mo'am rig 'dzin ma/ /blangs nas de sgrol mar bskyed de de dang snyoms par zhugs pas/nga rgyal rnam dag pa'i/ /bsam gtan pa de nor bu'i rigs| |'byung gnas su ni 'gyur ba'o/ /mjug bsdus nas bstan spyan dang lhan cig bsgrub na/sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob/mā ma kī dang bsgrub na/ mi bskyod par/ /'grub 'gyur dkar mo lhan cig tu/ /pad+ma can thob/dang sgrol ma dang*/ni/ /lhan cig don yod grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zer rin chen don sgrol ma/ rin chen ma rgyal rigs|dang 'grub/ /rigs pas 'dod pa 'di dag 'grub/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya la brten pa/'dis ni khro bo yi/ /bram ze la sogs pa spyan du bskyed pa lha dang rgyal ba'i sras po byang sems/dang*/ /bsgrub tsa na khro bo rab gtum zhe sdang gi bsam pa/cho ga dang*/ /bsam pa zhi ba zhi ba'i cho ga yis/ /zhi ba bzhi/rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /dbang bar 'dod chags kyi sid+dhi bsgrub tsa na/rgya chen zhen pa dang*/ /rat+na nga rgyal can gyi dngos grub bsgrub tsa na/ ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /thabs mchog tu gyur pa bsten par gdams pa gnyis/mchog tu gyur pa la brten pa'i nyes pa phan yon de ltar dka' ba med pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i/thabs// kun mkhyen thugs rje dang*/ bcas pas phyag rgya bsten par/bsngags/ /bsten pa lam du byed pa'i/ shin tu bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs/ /brtul zhugs spong ba lam du byed pa yang*/ dka' thub spyod pa spangs/ /ma bsten pa'i nyes pa de ltar bdud rtsi bsten pas bde ba dngos su byed pas/ro rnyed nas/

/nyon mongs gzhom phyir bsten pa la/mi brtson pa/ gang*/ /ji ltar dka' thub brtul zhugs des/ /spangs pa lam du byed pa/ sangs rgyas nyid ni bya bar nus//ste mi nus so//rang gi phyag rgya bsten pa/bde ba'i thabs rnyed nas/ /gang zhig bdag don mi byed pa/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid de yis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni gang du 'gyur/ /yang ni de kho na nyid/ni shes mi 'gyur/ /bsten pa'i phan yon 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad du/ /skye ba dam pas tshe 'di nyid la/mthong ba nyid/ /bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa'i las de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal/kun rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /sangs rgyas chos la snang la rang bzhin med pa/mi shes pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du/ /ji srid ma phyin bar du de bsten par/ bya/ /bcu pa las slob dpon sgrub pa po mi bskyod pa la sogs par/dang phyag rgya spyan la sogs pa bskyed/byin gyis brlab pa ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //'bras bu'i dus kyi ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang 'bras bu dngos so/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ /bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgya thob pa'i/gang du rig ma'i la brten pa/skyes bu mchog gi dngos grub/ grub pa der 'di lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ste/ sa la brten pa'i lha/'di dag dga' zhing mgu la rangs pas rnam pa drug tu g.yos nas bdud kyi gnas su cha lang lta bu'i sgra grags pa dang*/ phyogs bcur bskal pa'i me lta bu'i skar mda' ltung ba dang*/ rgya mtsho 'khrug pa'i sgra dang*/ thams cad du gnam rdo ltung ba dang*/ de nyid du bskal pa'i me'i gzugs lta bu'i ye shes kyi snang ba 'bar ba dang*/ phyag rgya'i skye gnas kyi snying por khams gsum thams cad snang ba ra mthong ba/dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ chu bdag dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ drag po dang*/ me dang*/ stobs bzang po dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*| gnod sbyin dang*/

grub pa dang*/ dri za dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye dang*/ lha'i mchog dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ chus byung la sogs pa gang zhig gzhan yang sum cu rtsa gsum du gnas pa'i lha rnams der 'ongs nas yang dag par dga' bas me tog gis mchod par byed do/ /pi wang dang*/ gling bu dang*/ mu kun+da dang*/ tam+bu ra dang*/ dung dang*/ zangs dung sgra dang*/ nan+di dang*/ pa ṭa ha dang*/ rdza rngas nam mkhar gnas te des rtag tu mchod par byed do/ /lha'i bu mo dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po'i bu mo thams cad kyis gar byed pa dang*/ sil snyan du ma byed pa dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi glu len par byed cing gar byed pa dang*/ de dag la dga' ba dang bcas pas bdud bzhi las/rgyal ba rgyal ba zhes pa'i sgras rtag tu rol bar byed pa dang*/ gang zhig grub pa nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis ni legs so'i rnam pa rab tu gsol bar mdzad do/ / gang zhig dga' ldan du gnas pa'i lha rab mchog dang*/ gang zhig lha'i bu dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'og min gyi bar du 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog sna tshogs kyi rnam pa dang*/ dri sna tshogs kyi dri'i char dang*/ bdug pa sna tshogs kyi khyad par gyis gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod par byed do/ /bsdus te bstan pa gzhan yang khyod la rgyas par bshad pa'i mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i mthu'am phan yon/ tshul gyis ci zhig dgos te/ bsgrub par bya ba'i bsod nams kyis khams gsum du skyes pa'i mchod pa de rnams kyis mchod par byed do/ /bcu pa las bde ba chen po'i dngos grub sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes/kyi mchod pa dang*/ rim gro zhes bya ba rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dngos/ de la gnyis/ zhus
